author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Shadowstone in this trailer for the upcoming run-based game where players take command of multiple heroes on a quest to escape monster-ridden ruins and save their corrupted realm from dark magic. Shadowstone will be available on PC in 2026. A demo is out now.

Set in the world of Sunderfolk, Shadowstone takes a sharp tonal turn, extending the universe into its darker, more dangerous corners. Build powerful synergies by upgrading and selecting complementary spells across heroes, and execute complex multi-hero ability combinations to devastate enemy monsters.
title: Shadowstone - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Top Hat Studios, Inc., a publisher specializing in Japanese-inspired and retro-themed games, hosts its seasonal Top Hat Studios Presents: Fall Showcase 2026, featuring fresh looks at new reveals, release announcements, demo drops, platform news, and other surprises. The presentation features hand-drawn animations as a nod to the publisher's portfolio style, and spotlights Top Hat Studios' catalog as it spans across genres and styles. As the publisher behind indie hits Labyrinth of The Demon King, Well Dweller, and MOTORSLICE, this fall’s presentation will give viewers a first look at games primed to become their next favorites. Top Hat Studios Presents: Fall Showcase 2026 puts the spotlight on developers bringing distinct creative visions to life.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Top Hat Studios Presents: Fall Showcase 2026

description: Take a look at the Console Launch Trailer for Mouthwashing, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Wrong Organ. Players will follow the tale of a shipwrecked space freighter and its crew on the edge of oblivion. Hear the last words of the crew, deal with extreme isolation, and come to terms with God paying no mind to your dilemma. Mouthwashing is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox on PC.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dive into the unsettling world of Asleep and see what's coming to the Final Act in this teaser trailer for the upcoming episode of the psychological horror game. Asleep: Final Act will be available on PC.

In Asleep: Final Act, Ana Lúcia is running out of light, and out of time. After two acts spent fighting her way through an endless loop of nightmares, she finally understands what put her there. But clarity comes at a cost: her mind is more fragile than ever, and even the places that once felt safe are no longer hers to trust. This is the Final Act of her pilgrimage. It's time to face her worst nightmare and find out if she has the courage to take the last step toward the abyss.
title: Asleep: Final Act - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Watch the latest trailer for The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster, an upcoming storybook adventure game. The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on May 13, 2027.

Step into a hand-drawn fairytale one book at a time in The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster. In this world, a magical disease known as Paper Mortis turns people into picture books, and picture books into monsters. 

The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster follows Mono, a young girl whose sister contracts this horrible malady. She'll do whatever it takes to save her sister from an incurable illness—including working with Mär, a monster hell-bent on vengeance. It'll take nothing less for her to traverse the Libratarium where her sister is kept.
title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Honkai: Star Rail trailer for this space fantasy RPG to learn more about what's coming. Honkai: Star Rail is available on the App Store, Google Play, PC, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).

From the trailer's official description:

"The horn to hunt the Voracity has sounded!
After a long Amber Era, the gods converge once more. THEY present a farce to the cosmos, igniting a new climax in the war among the Aeons.
No one knows the outcome of this deathmatch, but a fissure has already opened in the apocalypse...
A gaze peers into the cosmos from the future to the present, bringing a dead god back from hell.
Perhaps you will eventually meet, but at this moment, THEY declare to the universe...
The Trailblaze has no destination, just as the Elation requires laughter."
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Fables About the Stars Part 3: Myriad Celestia Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take another look at Agni: Village of Calamity in this new trailer for the upcoming survival horror game set against the backdrop of Indonesian folklore. The new trailer showcases threats Agni will face and more. The trailer also features "Blood and Bones”, an original dark country and rock track created for the game by A. Crow and Black Razor Records. Agni: Village of Calamity will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.

Agni, an investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality in Agni: Village of Calamity.
title: Agni: Village Of Calamity - Official Blood and Bones Trailer
